title: PAIS Cohort Database: post-acute infection syndrome cohorts, observations and estimates
description:
Cohort-level records of post-acute infection syndrome (PAIS) studies across pathogens (SARS-CoV-2, EBV, Giardia, Borrelia and others): study design, enrolment, follow-up, specimens, and harmonised observations, estimates, contrasts and predictors extracted from published papers. All values are study-level aggregates; no individual-level data.

Supersedes the git tag pais-v1.1 (July 2026). Short verbatim phrases in measure_verbatim are quoted from the cited papers (longest: one sentence).

Live, daily-updated version: https://research.opensourcemed.info/pais-cohorts.html. Built from commit a38b1a40ddb1 of the OSMF Research Tracker.

Research information, not medical advice.
